notes: Frozen study: 4 ABBA/BAAB blocks, 3 samples per process, 48 samples per workload total (24 per side).
Original study: 2 ABBA/BAAB blocks, 3 samples per process, 24 samples per workload total (12 per side).
Every sample constructs a fresh tokenizer outside timing. Previous result destruction and explicit gc.collect run before timing. Normal automatic GC remains enabled inside workloads.

Inputs are warm in the OS page cache. Text timings include JSONL reading, JSON decoding, tokenization, retained arrays, and held-out/training packing; model loading, output hashing and persistence are excluded.
Warm cProfile and tracemalloc diagnostics are separate from paired timings. Tracemalloc does not measure total RSS or Rust/native allocation.
No readout rendering or decision validation change is shipped. Rejected exploratory candidates and timing pilots are not used in these estimates.
